lines.text: Here at Yonsei Saebom Clinic,
we look after hormones, early puberty, exercise, posture and sleep,
to support healthy growth in children.
On the first visit, we take a detailed history — the child's age, height, and family background.
We check BMI for obesity, which helps predict early puberty.
A full-body X-ray shows bone age and how far the growth plates have closed.
Finally, blood tests and a puberty assessment check overall health.
From these results, we predict adult height and design a treatment plan for that child.
What makes us different?
We don't manage hormones alone. We also manage nutrition, sleep, exercise and puberty.
Caring for every factor that growth depends on, together — that is what sets us apart.
Posture matters a great deal for a growing child.
Exercise and physiotherapy play different roles.
Physiotherapy corrects problems in the bones and ligaments, so the body can hold the right posture.
But even once posture is corrected,
muscle has to be built through exercise to keep that posture.
Our clinic uses both physiotherapy and exercise to support a child's growth.
The right time to treat differs a little from child to child.
For girls, plan treatment a little earlier than for boys.
For girls, that is generally between ages eight and thirteen.
For boys, roughly between ages nine and fifteen.
But not for every child.
If early puberty is suspected,
or if another condition may be affecting growth,
treatment should begin somewhat earlier.
And if that window has passed, there is no need to worry too much.
It depends how much growth plate is left,
and how many centimetres you are hoping for. We can still plan treatment.
Don't worry — see a doctor near you and find out what is still possible.
When puberty begins, it affects growth in two main ways.
Early on, growth speeds up steadily.
Then after about one to two years,
the growth plates close, and growth slows down.
There is a window in your child's growth that matters most.
If you are worried about your child's height, don't leave it too late.
Checking and caring early helps a child grow to their full potential.
At Yonsei Saebom Clinic, we follow your child's growth closely,
with a treatment plan built for them, from detailed testing.
Talk to us today, for your child's growth ahead.
Visit dr187growup.com for a free height prediction.
